children: o1.exchange is set to unlock at least 10.69 million O tokens on 17 Nov 2027. The release covers allocations for the ecosystem, team and treasury.

The unlock makes more O available to sell. The release amount equals about 6.68% of the circulating supply, giving holders a figure to use when weighing how the added supply could affect the token's price around the unlock.
